sw16-17.name: The "Underpinning" Principle as step 2 has it, with the paragraph before it
sw16-17.text:
Have you done years of CBT or EMDR and yet you still get triggered and freeze or blow up? One reason to think about, is that standard therapy is trying to rewrite the "code" (your thoughts and behaviors), while the "motherboard" (the brain's physical structure and chemistry) is often overheating or damaged, and code doesn't run well on a motherboard like that. So to address that, I've designed this protocol to go after 5 specific neuro-biological problems (A to E below) before you go working on the psychology (well, alongside).

The "Underpinning" Principle: Bruce Perry compares treating trauma to building a house. Standard CBT & EMDR style therapies attempt to "decorate" the house (changing thoughts/behaviors in the Cortex) while the foundation (the Brainstem) is crumbling, and you can't hang curtains in a collapsing house.
